reviews.text: Let’s just say Bond Vet is the only place I would trust my pet entirely. My now 7 year old English bulldog, Valentina has been with Bond Vet since she was 3 months old. She received her first vaccines there and they have accompanied us through every emergency, stenotic nares surgery. Val was also spayed with Bond Vet and most recently after a scary diagnosis while she was outside of NY for a few months they assisted in reviewing her records and provided us with a second opinion. I am extremely thankful for their customer service and attention to detail. They always send over notes and results in a promptly timing which makes everything with insurance easier and smooth. Valentina now shares two homes and has a Vet outside of NY, but knowing that I can faithfully still count on Bond Vet for any questions or concerns is really comforting. Thank you for all that you do. Staff is amazing, their offices are always clean and organized. During this last rodeo, Valentina has been treated my Dr. Stephenson at the UWS 77th location and he is simply amazing, we are always receiving follow up messages to check on Val and its truly appreciated.
Exceptional service with a group of dedicated individuals who did everything they could to help my sick cat and make him more comfortable!

I visited Bond Vet UWS yesterday for the first time with my dog who wasn't feeling too well. It was such a pleasant experience. I had little to no wait to get back into the room, and also to see the vet once I was in the room. Dr Oak was so warm, friendly, knowledgeable & professional. We are new to NYC and extremely happy to have found a vet office that truly cares! They also sent a message checking in on my dog last night post visit. Thank you Dr. Oak and team for taking such great care of our girl. (BTW- they did not ask for this review- but they certainly deserved it!)
They are very accommodating and informative.  I feel as though my fur baby is safe and well looked after at this clinic

Bond Vet has been AMAZING! The front desk staff at West 91st Street and West 77th Street have been so helpful with assisting us with our cat via telephone, portal and phone calls up until we brought her in today. We enjoy bringing our cat to Bond Vet.
First time here, they treated my senior cat well and gave him treats. Doctors were articulated concerns and we have a health plan for my cat. Lobby is beautiful, staff is friendly. ♡

We absolutely love our vet! The whole team is caring, knowledgeable, and genuinely treats our dog like family. They always take the time to answer our questions and make sure we feel comfortable and informed. We’re so grateful to have such a wonderful team caring for our pup!

We came in here while visiting NYC and had an emergency with our Frenchie.  We were treated by Claire at the desk- super compassionate and helpful- and then Dr Travis.  They were all so kind and helpful and I only wished I lived here as I would be back with my baby!!!
Very friendly and responsive ! Clean environment. Free Snacks available for your pet.
Friendly staff and patient. Close to home so convenient

When my toy poodle was bitten by a bulldog they she her immediately and X-rayed and stitched her to save her life. This is the 2nd time visited that she has had bad dayeria with blood mixed in. They just made an appointment within 40 minutes.

Super nice place.
Nara is entirely at ease with the vet at BondVet

We had a great experience at Bond Vet. We got an appointment last minute for the next morning for our cat and they were so sweet to her. The vet and vet tech explained all the medications and tests she needs so clearly. Thank you!!

Perhaps my favorite bond vet location. Well laid out waiting room. Team is thorough & proactive & cost conscious.
And all the usual BV perks
Always a great experience at Bond. Staff is friendly and competent. They make our dog feel comfortable. Appointments start  on time.
We have been coming here for 6 years and have had great experiences every time. No complaints. The doctors and staff are always so friendly.

We just got home from bringing our cat in for a check up.  Our experience could not have gone better.  Claire welcomed us lovingly and was so helpful.  The place was incredibly immaculate.  Our cat was at ease right from the start.  London and Dr. Travis took great care of all of us and were clear and informative.  We had been looking around the UWS for a vet and decided to give Bond Vet a try.  We are so very glad we did.  Such an easy perfect experience.

This is a rave review for Dr. Hannah Sit. She squeezed in my visit  to her with my little dog, and could have not have shown more care, concern, expertise, and patience with him -- or with me, his worried human! I'm so grateful to have found her at the 77th Street Bond Vet. I wish that I could give her many more than five stars!
Been coming here with my dog the last 3 years! I’ve liked all the vets that have seen my dog. They are attentive to his needs and the staff is very communicative.
So far it has been great. I feel Senna is in very good hands.
Very clean, nice and professional.
This place is amazing; everyone knows what they’re doing. Plus, they’re gentle with the pets.
We love Bond Vet! They are always on time, the staff is so thoughtful and I always feel like my dog is in good hands. It’s consistent and reliable.
Great team at the UWS location! They are so good to my pup and he is actually happy to go to the vet!

I used this vet initially because they were close to my apartment and always got us in and out quickly. They are higher priced, but I was willing to tolerate this for the speed. Over the past year I’ve noticed escalating wait times and mediocre care. At my most recent visit I walked in and no one was at the reception desk and it took nearly 5 minutes before anyone came out to check us in. We then waited another 25 minutes in a relatively empty lobby to be seen for a simple vaccine booster. Meanwhile someone who arrived 15 minutes after us was seen before us. Given the disorganization at this practice, we won’t be returning.
The staff here is so nice. They made sure my anxious pup was comfortable and got all her yearly needs handled.
Always very attentive and great treats:)
Staff very kind, toward us and to our cat
My cat wasn't feeling well and thank God, they were able to see her the same day I call with my concerns. The staff and the doctor were amazing.
They are super kind, respectful, and responded so fast the following morning when I made an appointment the night before.

My dog wasn’t feeling well, and the team at Bond Vet ⁠was amazing. Everyone was kind, professional, and caring. They took great care of my pup and made the whole experience stress-free. Highly recommend!

bond vets have listened and been helpful when I’ve brought in my cat. they’ve tried to tailor their solutions to her situation and my preferences. I think it is a bit more expensive than other places based on my research but I love that I can get same day appointments

Had the best experience at this Bond Vet, would recommend it to anyone that is in need of care for their furry friend! The staff was so nice and our doctor was very thorough and educated while respecting our preferences and wishes!
Love Bond Vet!! So does Vito ♥️

Bond Vet on 77th once again treated my sweet Bruce with compassionate care and went above and beyond on treatment while also looking at ways to provide cost savings. Thank you for treating my pet like family while providing the best possible care!
Love taking my cat here! The Vets are very attentive
Great experience! Highly recommend

Everyone we worked with from start to finish was extremely helpful and very professional. The facility was inviting and was clearly setup by animal lovers. We will absolutely be coming back for future visits!
I was here with my sick cat Nooch. Dr Sit and Chloe were really knowledgeable and attentive. Great visit, highly recommend

I’ve never had a bad experience with this location. I’ve been to other vet clinics and I’ve had quite a few bad experiences with other clinics in the area. They treat my cat with nothing but respect and always assure me that my cat is in safe hands when I bring her in. The staff is very friendly and I highly recommend this clinic.
